source: corpus/22-character/RI-CHR02-race-and-standing.md §4c: '>= 60 lines, >= 12 of them addressed to a Dunmer player'. Round 1's whole build contained 8 hits on the vocabulary.
note: Five stances, per the item: a Saxhleel or Naga player is asked about, warned about, offered help against, or MISTAKEN FOR escaped stock; a Dunmer player is propositioned, congratulated, spat at, and once quietly asked for a favour. `kind` names which. Nothing here is a slur for its own sake and nothing here is a lecture: every line is something one person says to another person who is standing in front of them.
counts_note: Counted by the analyser, not declared here.

lines.x: Do not walk the south road alone after the third bell. This one is not being dramatic; this one is being specific.
If a wagon slows down beside you, get off the road. Do not look at who is driving it.
Two came through last month asking after marsh-born labour and they were not hiring.
The Empire made it illegal. The Empire is four hundred miles away and the road is here.
Do you have papers, or do you have a name that was written down once? They are not the same and only one of them helps.
Are you free? I have to ask. I have to write the answer down as well, which is the part people object to.
Were you taken? You do not have to say. It changes what I will sell you and not the price.
Is there a mark on your shoulder? No — then keep your sleeve down anyway, out here.
There is a boat that leaves at low water and does not carry a manifest. It costs nothing if you are the cargo.
If it ever comes to it, come to this house. The floor comes up.
The grove will hide four and no more. This one has done it twice and will do it again.
The band will take you off the bank and the bank you left from will not be found.
You are off the Tear wagon. — No? Then stand somewhere else, quickly, before it is decided for you.
You match a description and the description is of a man's property. I do not like the sentence either.
I will not deal with House stock. — Ah. My apology. It is a bad habit and it is the House's habit, not mine.
We are full. — You have money? Then we are not full, and I am sorry for the first answer.
They do not take you off the road any more. They buy you off a clerk, and the clerk smiles.
Do you know your egg-year? The Office asks it to be helpful and the Houses ask it to price you.
There is a name on the wall of the shrine for anyone who needs one for a season. Use it and put it back.
The cages under the pilings are old. They are also dry, which means they have been bailed.
We were told to expect a delivery. — You are not a delivery. Sit down.
How long since you ate? That is not a kind question, it is a diagnostic one, and the answer tells me where you have been.
There is a man in Helstrom who buys writs and sells people, and he does it in that order.
Below the waterline is ours. If you can get below the waterline, you are ours too, and none come down.
Do not tell a warmblood your hatch-name. Not because of what it means. Because of what a ledger does with it.
Free, indentured, or unrecorded? I have to tick one. Unrecorded is the one that gets you stopped.
Hands where I can see them — no. No, stand easy. You looked like a runner and you are not.
The channel past the drowned stones. It is not on any chart and the House boats draw too much.
Sleep with the shutter latched. Not for thieves.
Whose mark is on you? — None? Then I have insulted you and I will take it off the price.
There is work at the factor house that pays in House standing and not in coin. You will know whether that is a compliment.
You can walk into rooms the rest of us get turned out of. That is a skill and I will rent it.
I need a signature that reads as House. Nothing illegal. Nothing legal either, strictly.
Serjo. Good to see the House still sends people who can walk.
Your people built the road we are standing on and I say that to exactly one Dunmer a year.
You are the first of yours through here in a season who paid the asking price. It has been noted.
— No. Not you. Nothing personal and everything historical.
Get off the boards. I do not care what your paper says.
This one will not take root-water from your hand. This one will not explain why.
Two hundred and six names, and one of them is a child, and you have your grandmother's chin.
Quietly: there is a wagon that comes through and this town cannot stop it. You could. It would not be known that it was you.
Between us — there is a writ I cannot refuse to stamp and you could make it unstampable. Do not answer now.
You could ask at the factor house what happened to the ones from the spring. They will answer you. They will not answer me.
If you are going south anyway. There is a name I would like read off a manifest and I cannot get near one.
We are short a hand who can count and does not flinch. It is not a nice job and it is not the worst one on offer.
Your House keeps the road open and the Legion cannot, and I am obliged to be grateful about it.
The Arnesian War ended in a treaty that abolished the practice and created the exemptions, in that order, in the same document.
The Office does not recognise ownership of a person. The Office does recognise a labour indenture of ninety-nine years.
Every soul in this room knows what the wagons carry and every soul in this room has a reason not to say it.
We are ordered to stop it and not resourced to stop it, which is an order about paperwork.
There is no market for it here. There is a market forty miles down the road and this is where the road starts.
The town voted on it once. The vote went the right way and nothing changed, which taught the town about votes.
I have treated rope burn on fourteen people this year and written 'fall' fourteen times.
Read the tariff schedule. There is a line for 'transported labour' and it has a duty rate.
The floats on their nets are marked. You learn the marks. You learn them the way you learn weather.
We move people north for nothing and cargo south for money and I sleep fine.
There was a girl worked here two summers. Her people came for her. Not her family — her people.
They call it factoring. It has four words in the Empire and one word here.
The tree does not have a word for it. That is not innocence; that is what a tree is.
Above the waterline they buy each other. Below it, we do not, and the towns still think we are the animals.
I have turned two wagons back this year and both of them went round by the pass road the same night.
